reviews.title: The AI  is atrocious
reviews.text:
I like the app other than the meal counter is worthless. You can’t manually add your meals as it is controlled by AI. I can tell it “protein shake with 400 calories, 50 grams of protein, 13 grams of fiber and 6 carbs. And the stupid AI will add 200 calories, 3 grams protein, no fiber and 15 carbs. 

Just trash! 

I wouldn’t be using this app if I didn’t like the fast counter and water intake.

reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.text: I joined this app, but never received the required confirmation email, despite several requests. (No, it did not go to my spam folder) Either this app is a SCAM, or the programmers are too incompetent to have the platform generate confirmation emails. Either way, these are not people I want to do business with. To make matters worse, I am now in a terrible rabbit hole trying to get the charges reversed. Use at your own risk!

reviews.title: Accountability
reviews.text: This app is making more accountable to not just the app but myself.   Its flexibility makes it easier for me to do this around my schedule.   The motivation is sustaining me and gives me just that little boost that I need to keep me going.

reviews.title: Little help
reviews.text: This app is good to show you some easy movements but it does not help you with actual weight loss.

reviews.title: Help
reviews.text: Not finding very user friendly

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: I used this app daily, AND paid $70 for the yearly subscription. They just decided to “upgrade” it, and now I can’t use it at all without spending more money. I emailed support which gave me zero assistance. I’ve deleted the app. I can use the health app on iPhone to do the same thing. Pigs get fat, hogs get slaughtered. Do better.

reviews.title: Waste
reviews.text: It’s not at all like it used to be. You can’t customize how long to lose weight and how many calories you need to have a day they don’t let you do any of that. There’s no one to talk to and it’s all AI. The coaches generic answer answers. It’s not anything real. It’s a waste of money and I wouldn’t do it.

reviews.title: Simple - Blinky
reviews.text: I wish the app offered a better way to capture info. Lots of info I want to entered doesn’t scan by barcode or scan.

reviews.title: Recurring subscription scam!
reviews.text: Beware of this app. If you use it you’ll be signing up for a recurring subscription charge without your knowledge! These people should be in prison!

reviews.title: Cancelled still trying to charge
reviews.text: This app is not honest. Even after cancelling it continues to try and charge my account.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: Tried to cancel a subscription and got an AI run around .. they still charged me for current .. even though, I cancelled the same day.. save your money.. customer service is lacking.

reviews.title: Simple review
reviews.text:
Too much filling in information each day. You must log each thing as it happens. It would be easier to log everything at the end of the day. 
I always forget to begin fast. Exercises are not geared for aged who have problems with knee issues or back pain. Walking without the device (phone) does not record movements. Don’t carry phone around all day in the house. Just issues I noticed.

reviews.text: My fasting is wrong

reviews.title: Further to last review
reviews.text:
Update on day 5 - I have decided to go back to my original app Lose It - which is a lot less hassle.   

Simple just isn’t simple.  There is no way of saving meals or trying to get to AI to accurately remember last items and meals.  So it means repeatedly inputting individual items. It forgot what semi skimmed milk I had before and it first recorded I had logged 1000 ml, than a cup.  I just wanted it to record 30mls.  It’s not simple at all it’s time consuming and I don’t have the time to spend 20 mins or more trying to log basic meals like breakfast cereal, milk, blueberries etc!  Sorry but the AI is too inaccurate and frustrating for me.  It needs a lot more work.  It’s also strange that you can eat something high in fat and it gives you a happy smile as it’s high in protein.  But log a cup of tea and it starts to frown as it says you should drink more water!   What does it think tea is made of.  Sigh.   Unsubscribed 😞

=========

Im on day 3 of this so will reserve full judgement until later as to how it’s working out for me.   So far I would suggest it’s used more as a way of logging food and keeping track of fluid intake in a different way.        Some things are frustrating as I have told the app at the start I need a balanced diet that is not especially high in protein due to some kidney issues, yet it keeps suggesting adding protein, or making my next meal high in protein.   I keep reminding the AI Coach which (by the way just agrees with everything you say and repeat

reviews.title: Better Options Exist
reviews.text: This app is just terrible. It is difficult to use, and the feedback it gives includes information about food that is just factually incorrect. If you’re looking for a science based app to track calories and nutrition, the Zoe app is so much better.

reviews.title: Total False Advertising
reviews.text: If you clicked on an ad claiming it would give you the total number of steps per day you need to reach your goal weight based on your age and sex and current weight, then you were misled just like I was. Instead you get a workout plan. My plan didn’t even have walking in it. I went into the support and got connected with the AI agent and asked where I could find my target daily steps in the app. The AI agent responded that the app doesn’t give you that information. Instead it gives you a workout plan that may include walking for that day. What a joke. I want a walking plan that gives me the number of steps I need just like the false advertising claims. This is a dishonest company steer clear.

reviews.title: No Option to End
reviews.text: I thought I was getting a trial version only to learn it keeps charging me. Struggling to find a cancel option.

reviews.title: It was great till it got political!
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the app and it helped me lose weight but as time went on it seemed more like a way for some people to state their political views, I for one am not against that but it should be a place for people to encourage each other in their weight loss journey and not have to worry about it turning into a political app!

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: The app may have  potential and will lure you to subscribe. But after paying £19 for three months plan you will receive a notice to pay £74.99 and no matter how you plan to unsubscribe or deactivate there is no way out!

reviews.title: Be careful this is a £79 subscription!
reviews.text: Two lots of £79 have been taken from my account without me knowingly authorising this. When looking in to this ‘subscription’ - simple state that they give you 3 days notice of any money being taken from your account. I have NEVER received any reminders or notifications hence these payments were taken against my knowledge as had I been notified I would have cancelled it before they had chance to take it. Also, money saving tip for everyone that’s happily paying these costs - no idea why you would be - when you try to cancel they’ll offer you a £5 a month subscription for life! Makes an absolute mockery of the £79 - criminal

reviews.title: Fooled by the add
reviews.text: I saw an add on instagram that tricked me into getting this app. I would’ve done better with my fitness pal or another food tracker. This app continually made negative comments, the calls were always glitchy, requires you to login multiple times a day and at the end of the day. I repeatedly asked for no more negative comments, yet the app continued to shame me. If you have low energy one day because you’re sick or something, it will remind you of something you ate the day before that could’ve caused this “remember those noodles in the chicken noodle soup, those could be to blame for this dip in energy. Might want to skip the noodles next time”. Could I ignore the negative comment? Sure can. But it was nearly every single choice I made or didn’t make. It tells you that it’s healthy to weigh yourself daily. It encourages extremely low calorie meals and praises you for having a daily intake of a few hundred calories. Anyone with an eating disorder should avoid this app like the plague.  Unfortunately, I paid for several months of this trap app and am stopping use of it before my paid period is up and switching to a free calorie counter to avoid all the negative comments I keep receiving. I took a couple of days off and the app is sending me nasty notifications like the threats are going to make me want to use it again.  I really wanted to like this app, but I did not enjoy anything about it. I wish they offered a money back guarantee…

reviews.title: Do not download
reviews.text: App is doing exactly what free app Fitatu does. I’ve paid £10 through Apple Pay and after a month they’ve tried to charge me £44 without my permission. Total scam!

reviews.title: Really pricey after the initial trial
reviews.text: I really didn’t like this app.  I didn’t find it helpful, it’s AI based.  The initial few months are well priced then it gets really pricey quickly after

reviews.title: Fraudulent app
reviews.text: After paying for subscription, the app still asks you to pay additional money to subscribe to premium. The app is basically useless without the premium subscription. Why then do you deceive people? I regret even downloading the app.

reviews.title: Scam for money
reviews.text: Please be very careful when signing up for this account. They will automatically charge you £48 for the workbook meal plans without making this charge clear to you at all. Moreover they add you account and store your credit card details to a premium plan, meaning that they will randomly charge you the premium price of £44 a month. Luckily their support team is very good and i received refunds for both of these payments. However the app in general is full of payment traps so be careful.

reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text: This App may suit some people, it was not good for me. It’s very hard to cancel the subscription and after I had cancelled they tried to collect another annual subscription, luckily my bank declined.

reviews.title: Good exercises
reviews.text: Inaccurate food recording, I even tell the app how much protein and calories I’ve consumed at each meal and it records something completely different! 🤷🏼‍♀️

reviews.title: Watch out for subscription
reviews.text: Be incredibly careful when signing up for a trial or subscription with Simple Life. They auto-renewed my account for a massive £79 annual fee without sending any prior notification email or warning.Please note: simply deleting or removing the app from your phone does NOT cancel the website billing database. They will keep charging your card.I only managed to get my money back because I threatened a formal chargeback dispute with American Express and cited consumer notification rights. Check your bank statements closely—this company relies on sneaky subscription traps. 1 star.

reviews.title: Could be great, but isn’t
reviews.text: I love the user interface, look and feel of this app. But as a food tracker, it’s rubbish. Over estimated my calorie intake by a third across the day, and there is no way to correct it. Insult to injury, then started giving me a sad face when my food intake was actually good. Needs a barcode scanner and a way to accurately input nutritional values. Deleted the app as it was stressing me out

reviews.title: Not easy to unsubscribe or cancel
reviews.text:
Found this ap useful for workouts! But realised it was expensive even on an offer plan ! When the plan I subscribed too was three days of finishing, I decided to cancel but the only option on ap was to pause!
So paused it till April as it was the only option and as soon as I did that it froze me out of my premium plan and I still had three days to go. Asked for help on the ap chat and all I got was I get my three days back when I  renewed my subscription in April! I asked how to cancel completely and got no answer. I am now waiting for a further reply which apparently be in 2-4 days.  They showed me a screenshot that it has been cancelled but to be renewed in April, which I don’t want! I want my three days owed in the original plan and then cancel altogether.
